news.title: Meta is reportedly developing an AI pendant
news.description: Meta seems to be making big bets on AI-powered hardware.

news.title: I put Google’s 24/7 AI assistant Gemini Spark to work, and it’s actually pretty useful
news.description: Gemini Spark helps automate everyday tasks, from inbox summaries to local event planning, but it’s unclear why Google made it a separate product.

news.title: Coders are refusing to work without AI — and that could come back to bite them
news.description: While AI is helping coders produce code faster, it may not be producing better code, researchers warn. And that could cause problems down the road for them.

news.title: Amazon Is Making an AI-Animated ‘Good Advice Cupcake’ TV Show. Its Original Creator Is Furious
news.description: Loryn Brantz created The Good Advice Cupcake for BuzzFeed years ago. The company licensed the character for a new Amazon series—made with AI—without her consent.

news.title: We Asked the ‘Future of Truth’ Author to Explain How He Used AI. It Didn’t Go Well
news.description: A book about how AI shapes perceptions of reality came under fire for using AI-generated quotes. Its problems go beyond that.

news.title: Millions of AI agents imperiled by critical vulnerability in open source package
news.description: "BadHost" was found in Starlette, a package with 325 million weekly downloads.

news.title: US law enforcement warns of "anti-tech extremism" as AI hatred grows
news.description: Over 1,000 pages of DHS, FBI, and fusion center documents reveal a new domestic threat category: anti-tech extremism fueled by AI job displacement concerns.

news.title: Robinhood now lets your AI agents trade stocks
news.description: Users can create dedicated wallets for AI agents to trade stocks, with fraud detection and trade previews.
